verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's coding-agent template ships with `sandbox0-browser`, Google Chrome Stable, Playwright CLI, TigerVNC, the Openbox window manager and a built-in noVNC viewer. That covers both headless-browser automation and a viewable desktop session inside the sandbox. Custom images and software installation give further room to extend the environment. Missing for 10: a dedicated in-depth browser/desktop documentation page (the evidence is a single line in a use-case page), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the browser and desktop work as described.
